lines.trans: Hello, guys! How are your things?
Senya, are you nearly done? I need the foam!
I will just shave my right arm, and that's it.
And what are you doing? Shaving your arms?
Today is the fifteenth, a big sanitary inspection!
Hair must not fall into the food!
Come on, this is complete nonsense!
This is a strict rule of the sanitary inspection.
If they find even one hair — you'll be fired immediately!
Why didn't you warn me earlier?
I don't even have a razor with me.
All right, runt, take my razor.
For arms I don't mind the razor at all.
Thank you, Fedya, I will quickly shave everything.
